en: Hi!\nWelcome to our BIKE SHOP.\pHave we got just the BIKE for\nyou!
Oh, that's…\pA BIKE VOUCHER!\pOkay!\nHere you go!
{PLAYER} exchanged the\nBIKE VOUCHER for a BICYCLE.
How do you like your new BICYCLE?\nDo you like how it rides?\pYou can take it out on CYCLING\nROAD and even into caves!
You better make room for your\nBICYCLE!
A plain city bike is good enough\nfor me.\pAfter all, you can't put a shopping\nbasket on a mountain bike.
These bikes are cool, but they're\nway expensive!
